cases.name: registration-begin-pending-enrollment
cases.assertion: Registration begin created a pending enrollment and returned the application verification challenge over real HTTP.

cases.name: registration-complete-pending-credential
cases.assertion: Registration complete persisted a credential linked to the pending enrollment over real HTTP.

cases.name: authentication-denied-before-verification
cases.assertion: Pending enrollment authentication was denied before verification: email_unverified: Verify the email address before using a passkey..

cases.name: verification-activation
cases.assertion: The application atomically activated the pending account and enrolled credential through the real verification route.

cases.name: registration-begin-success
cases.assertion: Registration begin returned application-generated persisted ceremony options over real HTTP.

cases.name: registration-begin-no-session-unauthorized
cases.assertion: The application denied a real HTTP request without the authenticated session cookie.

cases.name: registration-begin-unverified-email
cases.assertion: The persisted unverified account was denied by the application with code email_unverified.

cases.name: registration-begin-unverified-pin
cases.assertion: The application denied pinVerified=false with code pin_required over real HTTP.

cases.name: authentication-begin-unverified-email
cases.assertion: The persisted unverified account was denied by the application with code email_unverified.

cases.name: authentication-begin-unverified-pin
cases.assertion: The application denied authentication with pinVerified=false and code pin_required over real HTTP.

cases.name: registration-complete-persisted-challenge-mismatch
cases.assertion: A valid response for one persisted begin challenge was submitted with another persisted challenge ID and the application returned challenge_mismatch: The passkey ceremony could not be completed..

cases.name: registration-complete-expired-challenge
cases.assertion: A valid attestation for the application-returned challenge was rejected after the bounded test clock advanced: challenge_mismatch: The passkey ceremony could not be completed..

cases.name: registration-complete-success
cases.assertion: Registration completion persisted the generated credential through the real HTTP application path.

cases.name: authentication-begin-success
cases.assertion: Authentication begin returned application-generated persisted ceremony options over real HTTP.

cases.name: authentication-complete-consumed-replay
cases.assertion: A second valid assertion targeted the already consumed challenge and the application returned challenge_replayed: The passkey ceremony could not be completed..

cases.name: authentication-complete-origin-mismatch
cases.assertion: A validly signed assertion with a wrong origin was rejected by the application: platform_error: The passkey ceremony could not be completed..

cases.name: authentication-complete-rp-mismatch
cases.assertion: A validly signed assertion with a wrong RP hash was rejected by the application: platform_error: The passkey ceremony could not be completed..

cases.name: authentication-complete-success
cases.assertion: Authentication completion returned the application-derived authenticated result over real HTTP.
